opening.argument: The video presents a Domino's-themed game alongside a promised free pizza, placing the offer in an ordinary branded-promotion context: its description says viewers only have to play a game designed by Domino's to receive one. The later screens reinforce that context by showing routine ordering and rewards-related information, including qualifying orders and points. Those materials provide context for a promotion rather than establishing deception or a harmful transaction mechanism. The available records do not verify the offer's eligibility rules, fulfillment, or official status, so they support the existence of a promotional presentation without proving more than that.

citations.quote: You only have to play a game designed by dominos to get a FREE pizza!
